THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: DSO/HOM/LAC/132-LA/99/2022.

Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/5/2020/HW/217. I hereby give notice, under Sub- section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands, which are required for a public purpose :

Description of the lands to be acquired : Lot Nos. 01 to 86 (No. of Lots 47) allotments in total extent of about 2.2702 Hectares, of land in Cadastral Map No. 520037/15/12 and dated 16.12.2023 prepared by the Senior-Superintendent of Surveyor of Colombo District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Homagama in Colombo District in the Western Province.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT
Notice Under Section 7

Ref. No.: DSM/YT/LAND/5/35. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/9/2016/A/346. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land/servitude to be acquired : The Allotment of Land in extent of 0.1595 hectare of the land called Dangan Estate depicted in Sheet 1, Block 6 of the Cadastral Map No. 310401, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Divilla in the Grama Niladhari Division No. E 337B of Dangan Place in Karangoda Asgiri Pallesiya Pattu Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Yatawatte in Matale District of the Central Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Dangan Estate; Description : For and official quarters for Extension Officers of the Export Agriculture Department; Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent : 0.0037 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land : Dangan Estate; Description : For and official quarters for Extension Officers of the Export Agriculture Department; Claimant : State; Original Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent : 0.1523 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land : Dangan Estate; Description : For and official quarters for Extension Officers of the Export Agriculture Department; Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent : 0.0035 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Yatawatte on the 03rd June, 2024, at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th May 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
H. M. M. C. P. Hindagoda, Divisional Secretary, Yatawatta. At Yatawatta Divisional Secretariat. 22nd April, 2024 EOG 04 - 0228
